## C01: boot, activation, independent rollout eligibility

Core Enums/Cas/ScanMode string off/new_content_only/all_content и Content/ScanPolicySpec readonly(predicateKey,mode,scannerKey,scannerVersion,policyVersion,rolloutKey); scanner/policy ids ASCII [a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{1,64}. P3.6 extends UploadPolicy constructor ONLY appended optional ?ScanMode $scanMode=null, ?string $scanPolicyVersion=null; existing requireScan named arg unchanged. profile null inherits global mode/version; profile false/off does not subtract global eligibility. Explicit requireScan=true always all_content; true plus explicit off/new_content_only contradictory→boot invalid config. Bool false/null with no mode yields off/inherit as declared; supplied global required=false + mode=all_content valid. Never max(mode) between two boundaries.
Canonical global vaulter.scan: mode=null (normalizes off), required=null (normalizes false), scanner=null (FQCN implements ContentScanner), scanner_key=null, scanner_version=null, policy_version=null (normalizes '1'), rollout_key=null. Compatibility vaulter-drive.uploads.scan.{required,mode,scanner,scanner_key,scanner_version,policy_version,rollout_key} defaults all null and accepted as alias ONLY when canonical value null/unset; both non-null unequal values boot error, equal duplicates accepted. No runtime precedence guess. Core ScanConfig supplies normalized global spec; drive DriveConfig supplies work settings only: queue='default', lease_seconds=120, scanner_timeout_seconds=60, max_attempts=5, publish_cooldown_seconds=30, recovery_batch=100, cleanup_batch=100. Validate positive ints, batch1..1000; scanner deadline<job timeout90<lease120<broker retry_after>=180. Host scanner binding/FQCN/version mismatch or absence for ANY enabled global/profile required/new-content enforcement→ConfigurationException on boot in all env; optional off scanner absent allowed. P3.6 schema-free algebra, P3.7 actual scanner/queue validation; no DB query on core profile boot before migrations.
Profile required condition for revision r = all_content OR (new_content_only AND r.scan_admission_sequence > persisted boundary). Egress requires both global and profile conditions, checks current state/config spec hash per call; any matching predicate requires clean evidence for its exact spec_key. off allows no mandatory condition; infected always denied. Missing rollout state or runtime-vs-persisted config fingerprint mismatch→configuration error/fail closed, never grandfather by first read. Newly provisioned drive persists both policy states with boundary0 before admitting its first revision. Existing enabled drives use bounded explicit activation command, not read-time automatic cutoff. Legacy revision admission0 is eligible for exemption only under stored new-content boundary; timestamps/IDs/client flags play no role.
Activation transaction: exclusive drive tree T, fresh drive row Q; capture current scan_admission_sequence for first new_content_only activation, persist immutable rollout_key+boundary and both selected policy specs atomically for that drive. Existing boundary reused on reactivation, cannot reset with a fresh token. Ingest/copy/restoreRevision all hold shared/exclusive T through commit: at Q position after N/F/R validate policy config/spec against persisted state, increment drive counter and assign new revision's admission; then lock and write the exact blob and edge (C) and only after that ensure required obligations and evidence (W). C→W matches I17, settle, requestRescan and backfill. ensure insert-or-select never acquires W before C. CAS, counter and obligation failure roll back the same outer transaction; no Q→N/T and no W→C path. Existing writers excluded from admission during activation by exclusive T; resumed outer retry revalidates spec. Scan counter independent from node.sequence and file.revision_count.
Rollout procedure: migrate additive schema; prepare scanner+versions in off, activate specs, rescan all selected legacy revisions to produce candidate evidence; check counters/status, then set all_content and activate identical scanner/policy versions (mode changes do not invalidate clean). Or explicit new_content_only with nonblank rollout_key, quiesce old unpatched writers, activate each drive under T, then admit patched traffic. During mixed deployment any stale spec mismatch rejects mutations/egress; active requests admitted before cutover are not retroactively interrupted. Never an automatic startup backfill or grandfathering. New scanner/policy version activates a new spec; old evidence fails compatibility immediately, bounded backfill prepares new spec. P7.2 owns production schedules, P8.2 historical-chain upgrade; P3.7 supplies working commands now.
For pre-existing revisions becoming required, activation atomically creates/extends scan_backfill_runs to the captured drive counter for each required spec. Revision egress blocks immediately even before its per-revision work is materialized; durable run represents that legacy-discovery obligation. Reconciler expands missing work boundedly, so no infinite pending gap after interrupted manual backfill. Every NEW required revision still records its own work in creation outer transaction; legacy discovery is not falsely claimed to insert an unbounded drive history atomically.
Appended profile scanPolicyVersion can strengthen with independent spec but cannot remove global required predicate; supplied profile scanner version always same bound scanner. A profile scanMode=off while global all_content still contributes no subtraction. ScanConfig uses null defaults for all canonical/alias policy keys before normalization; canonical non-null vs alias non-null detects explicit conflict. It does not try to infer owner intent from default-populated config-array key presence. Canonical off+scanner null carries internal scanner key/version none only for no-work policy; rescan mode off still requires configured real scanner before creating optional work. Missing scanner optional rescan returns2, no impossible job. Core-only default resolver disabled/off is explicit, profile required=true while drive runtime absent fails before egress, no silently exempt optional package.

## C03: generation, lease, publication, settle

Initial ensure locks revision under normal family locks, insert-or-select UNIQUE(revision,spec); creates generation1/attempt0/pending, request row. Same outer rollback removes both revision and intent; compatible clean reuse creates own target obligation+request+evidence and settled/clean atomically. afterCommit on Vaulter connection OUTERMOST commit only publishes (id,generation); catches broker exception into safe diagnostic, leaves pending. No webhook OutboxRelay/feature dependency, no pre-commit queue job. Every required admission has durable own obligation even reused clean; optional off content need not have work until explicit rescan.
| Trigger | Locked transition and fence |
|---|---|
| claim due pending/retry_wait or expired leased | W-only short transaction; re-fetch generation, due time/state, increment attempt, fresh server UUID lease_token + expiresAt, leased; duplicate active lease→null. attempt<=5. Commit before IO. |
| explicit requestRescan | T/N/F/R/C→W; new UNIQUE request_key ledger allocates generation+1, attempt0/pending, clears old lease; unchanged old request_key is no-op regardless intervening requests. New epoch creates separate spec obligation. Overflow→deterministic exception+rollback. Old queued gen loses. |
| clean/infected result | short settle T(shared)→N→F→R→C→W; validate existing exact revision→file→node→drive/tenant, blob/edge committed immutable identity, spec, generation/attempt/token and lease still live; append result evidence UNIQUE(request,attempt), settled/outcome; duplicate settlement returns false. No update WHERE file_id of head. |
| transient failed | same fence; append failed evidence, reason scanner_timeout/scanner_unavailable/transient_io, retryable=true; attempt<5→retry_wait + next time, clears lease; otherwise settled/failed reason attempts_exhausted, preserves prior evidence. Backoff after attempts1..4:30,120,600,1800 seconds from DB clock. |
| deterministic unavailable | unsupported/too_large/password_protected/access_denied/unknown/content_identity_mismatch→failed evidence, retryable=false, settled/failed; unclassified exception→unknown not clean. Explicit rescan after remediation creates new generation. |
| expired lease at attempt5 | recovery sets settled/failed attempts_exhausted with fenced failed evidence; never forever leased. No auto infinite retries, doctor/operator sees terminal failure. |
| deleted revision | FK cascade has removed work; claim/read/settle returns no-op with safe reason, no resurrect/repoint. wrong scope/identity before bytes fails job without retry; row not settled as clean, no foreign mutation. |
ScanAttempt readonly snapshots obligation/revision/blob/drive/tenant/contentIdentity/spec/generation/attempt/token/deadline. Job payload ONLY obligation_id+generation+drive_id+tenant_id (no raw storage key/user/system flag); authoritative row loaded before scope checks. Job has framework tries=1: SQL work scheduler owns retries, broker redelivery still allowed. Host tenancy middleware restores first; Vaulter validates second (P3.8). Configuration/version mismatch blocks read/claim processing until deployment fixed, not silent old-spec scan. Scanner IO outside SQL transaction, within60s deadline. Job timeout90, lease120, retry_after>=180; bounded timeout/kill tests require owning worker process to terminate, no promise that generic PHP interface can interrupt malicious host code.
Public ContentAvailabilityGuard precedence after locator/actor/ACL/profile: authoritative legacy scan_status=infected OR revision/blob quarantined_at OR unrevoked infected evidence for exact scoped bytes→423; any required predicate without compatible unrevoked clean→423; otherwise allowed. Work failed/pending never produces clean. scan_status retained projection: infected priority, then current-compatible clean, then live pending, then failed, else not_required. Thus optional failed rescan leaves projection clean when valid evidence exists; work failure remains visible separately. Bare legacy clean string without versioned evidence is not required-mode proof. clean/infected terminal per attempt only. Infected sets revision AND immutable blob quarantine in same settle; later clean, same SHA reupload, COPY, restore or rescan never clears it. No P3 release-quarantine workflow; future explicit authorized audit workflow required, not a late worker or config off.
Expiry exhaustion is a recovery CAS under the authoritative scoped W row, writes failed evidence using its immutable snapshot; it never uses normal clean settle with an expired token and never changes blob/head. Scan job clean settlement requires live lease; rejected callback is no-op. Scope-validation job failure leaves work diagnostically stalled/terminal failed under correct maintenance recovery, never retries into a different tenant.
Obsolete spec recovery: AFTER active policy activation has committed new required backfill intent, reconcile recognizes obligation.spec_key absent from current global/profile specs (off specs included), scoped W CAS leased/pending/retry_wait→settled/failed reason=superseded_policy/retryable=false and clears token. Stale worker then cannot settle, no clean/evidence or head change from invalid engine version. Old retained compatible evidence remains forensic and can qualify only if exact same spec later explicitly configured; sticky infection unaffected. Running settle also validates spec is current before result append; mode change with same spec does not obsolete evidence. Missing/mismatched deployment config without a completed new activation is stalled_configuration, not prematurely superseded.
Legacy infection cannot launder before evidence backfill: availability/admission/reuse query authoritative existing revision scan_status=infected through exact blob_id or file_revision_blobs edge for the selected physical blob and persisted scope, even when quarantined_at/evidence still NULL. Never search another tenant by digest as authority. Matching legacy infection denies public bytes/new admission and clean reuse; trusted maintenance may stamp sticky blob/revision quarantine at detection. Historical rows/timestamps/scan_status remain unchanged in migration, no fabricated clean verdict. Same immutable blob infection can deny reupload of those bytes; no public disclosure of the other revision/tenant id. SEC-R06 and infected reupload fixture include legacy infected/no evidence case.

## C02: evidence compatibility, COPY/restore, revocation

Core Contracts/Cas/ContentScanner methods key():string, version():string, scan(ScanInput $input):ScanResult; key/version must exactly equal configured scanner identity on boot and immediately before IO. ScanInput readonly(stream, revisionId, blobId, driveId, tenantId, scopeKey, sha256, size, detectedMime, scannerVersion, policyVersion, DateTimeImmutable deadline); stream is owned by service, scanner borrows and cannot convert all bytes to a string. ScanResult readonly(ScanVerdict $verdict,?string $reason=null,bool $retryable=false); ScanVerdict enum Clean='clean',Infected='infected',Failed='failed'. Clean/Infected with reason/retryable contradictory reject; failed reason from closed taxonomy in StateMachine. No raw engine signatures/paths in public payload. Fake fixtures read actual immutable bytes, bounded chunks, return structured results; external AV setup stays host-owned.
Drive Content/PrivateScanReader::open(ScanAttempt $attempt):mixed (@return resource|null) internally reloads authoritative work and current live lease, revision/file/node/drive/tenant, blob scope/disk/storage key and edge/size/digest before BlobStore::read. No scalar public capability constructor, no Request flag, no extension asSystem shortcut. Capability created by claim, consumed only by ScanFileRevision in same trusted integration. Read can access quarantined bytes and ignores public Download feature/availability, never bypasses tenant or exact attempt fence. Job finally closes stream on success/throw/timeout process teardown; framework middleware cannot mint URL. Core cannot import this drive service. Host PHP is trusted, raw BlobStore/StorageDriver is storage API, not an application authorization boundary.
compatible evidence requires persisted revision/blob/edge identity, same drive+tenant+scope (P3 permits reuse ONLY same drive), sha256+size exact, spec_key exact scanner+policy version, clean outcome, no revoked_at, no revision/blob quarantine or scoped infected evidence. No sharing by digest across drives/tenants. Evidence new spec not inferred compatible by version ordering, no automatic age-expiry in P3; revoked row unavailable immediately, later new evidence may requalify only if no sticky infection. Revoke reason/context audit via existing identity plumbing, no false P5 durable guarantee.
COPY preflights subtree support and source availability under source policy; infected source refuses before target writes. Copies retained immutable revisions/edges, calculates own admission sequence for every new revision, evaluates destination policy and ensures own obligation. Legacy exemption/not_required/string clean/work lease never copied. If same-drive compatible clean permitted, insert target evidence with reused_from_id and target identity; own obligation settled/clean, no network/job; off source pending/failed→required target pending/own job. Cross-drive COPY remains whatever current API permits, but evidence cannot reuse. restoreRevision creates new revision/head with same destination policy and fresh admission; historical clean reusable under exact identity/version/scope, infected source refuses. Trash restore retains revision/admission identity, rechecks current policy; can restore metadata while bytes blocked, recovery/backfill supplies missing work. Reading explicit older clean revision allowed when that exact evidence qualifies; head read never substitutes old clean revision. Work/evidence changes do not bump node.sequence, quota, head or revision allocation number.

## C03/C09: exact commands, bounded rescan/reconcile/cleanup

Commands are package Console owners registered by drive Providers/ConsoleRegistrar. Signatures (all ids opaque package int|string, scopes authenticated maintenance, no external cloud commands):
vaulter:scan-reconcile {--tenant=} {--drive=} {--all-tenants} {--reason=} {--limit=100} {--max-seconds=30} {--dry-run} {--json}
vaulter:scan-rescan {--tenant=} {--drive=} {--all-tenants} {--reason=} {--revision=*} {--after=} {--limit=100} {--request-id=} {--rescan} {--retry-failed} {--activate-policy} {--dry-run} {--json}
Enabled tenancy requires --tenant or explicit --all-tenants + reason; contradictory scopes error before SQL; drive must belong to selected tenant, --revision belongs to selected drive(s). --all-tenants uses bounded scoped withoutTenancy wrapper + system reason, derives scope from every persisted drive; P3.8 forbids passing bypass to queued scanner. reason nonblank<=191 for mutating operations; default reason vaulter:scan-reconcile only for single selected tenant; global all-tenants never defaults. limit1..1000, max-seconds1..60. Invalid flags/cursor return2 no changes; unexpected scope corruption fail1 with safe summary; success0 means scheduled/processed intents, not all clean. --rescan/--retry-failed mutually exclusive; --activate-policy forbids --revision and --rescan/--retry-failed (separate bounded drive activation). --dry-run writes nothing, publishes nothing, prints predicted counts only.
rescan without --activate-policy selects revisions by drive_id,scan_admission_sequence,id ASC (DB key type order) and exact current specs even mode off; missing work→ensure; existing valid clean→skip; nonterminal→reuse; terminal fail→skip unless --retry-failed; --rescan explicitly new request generation for every selected spec even clean. Missing request-id generates UUID once and prints it; resumed --after must retain printed request-id. Cursor is HMAC-signed JSON{version,request_id,mode,tenant,drive,filters,spec_keys,last_drive_id,last_revision_id}; reject altered scope/spec/flags with2. Request dedup ledger makes retry of page idempotent. --activate-policy pages drive_id with same signed shape and captures boundary under T; idempotent repeat existing rollout boundary. Inserts own obligations+requests under each revision family locks, safe no head/quota changes. Output JSON schema: version1, command, request_id, scanned, activated, created, reused, skipped, failed, published, cleanup_completed, next_cursor|null, elapsed_ms, dry_run. Counts explicit nonnegative; no tokens/URLs/storage paths/foreign ids in diagnostics. Tests inspect durable row counts, not CLI exit only.
reconcile one pass selects <=limit due W ids using indexes, canonical available_at,id ASC, short row claim/expired-lease reset CAS; no W lock held when acquiring T/N. Expired attempts<5→retry_wait due now, clears lease/fences old token; expired5→settled failed. Pending/retry_wait publication after own committed update, every cooldown30s until actual worker claims; last_published_at is scheduling hint, never terminal/dispatched. Publish failure leaves due intent; lost ACK/redelivery safe by claim fencing. A continually failing row gets available_at cooldown to avoid starving other rows; no unbounded while loop, stop at count/time bound and report remaining_due. terminal failures stay visible until explicit rescan, not erased by scheduler. No scan obligation pruned while revision exists.
Same command independently reclaims <=cleanup_batch committed upload_sessions with cleanup_pending=true, due cleanup_available_at, session mutex; deletes only exact session-owned staging parts+assembled file, sets cleanup false after success in new transaction. Failure leaves flag, retries30/120/600/1800 then daily cap3600 seconds (cleanup never silently abandoned), increments cleanup_attempts, safe reason. Sessions marked committed are never re-ingested. Probe loops obey max-seconds even under failure. dry-run covers cleanup too.
Minimal host schedule in UPGRADE docs (P3.7 executable now): Schedule::command('vaulter:scan-reconcile --all-tenants --reason=scheduled-scan-recovery --limit=100 --max-seconds=30')->everyMinute()->withoutOverlapping(2); DB CAS remains multi-scheduler guard (cache lock not authority). Disabled-tenancy standalone omit --all-tenants and use explicit system reason. Bootstrap activation/backfill invoked intentionally, no periodic --rescan all clean policy. P7.1 doctor/P7.2 production orchestration/P7.4 host fixtures/P7.6 docs remain mandatory; P3 supplies functioning baseline and queue middleware ordering.
ScanBackfillReconciler::expand(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30):array selects pending runs without holding run lock, then revisions ordered by (scan_admission_sequence,id) within drive and <=target_sequence. For each revision: take normal T/N/F/R/C family locks, ensure missing work with stable run request_key, then lock run last and CAS its original cursor tuple→processed tuple in SAME transaction. Competing cursor CAS loser rolls back its redundant materialization and reloads; no run-lock→T path. Compatible evidence may settle work, existing work reused, never force rescan generation. Deleted selected revision safely advances tuple. Reaches snapshot end→completed; activation that extends target reopens completed cursor without resetting admission boundary or old request ledger. New admissions >old target cannot fall below cursor regardless UUID/ULID order. Run lease is unnecessary: transaction CAS/unique work plus repeated scheduler recovers crash; no IO while locked. Reconcile includes <=limit expansion and <=limit work publications and <=cleanup_batch cleanup, all within max-seconds admission budget; time limit checked between units, a single bounded DB call cannot be preempted and timeout is governed by DB statement/lock timeout. Counts JSON adds backfill_materialized, backfill_remaining; no assertion that limit is hard wall-clock cancellation. --after CLI rescan cursor also uses admission_sequence,id within each drive, never bare UUID monotonicity. Scope/spec change rejects prior cursor; explicit activation state desired-spec fingerprint includes rollout key and mode. Three loops are finite, not while pending until empty.

Config version mismatch: reconciler keeps intents due but emits stalled_configuration count, no private reads/settle clean; operator deploys compatible versions then reactivates/restarts. Explicit rescan of old desired spec requires currently bound matching scanner, no processing obsolete version by newer scanner. After committed replacement policy activation legacy inactive-spec work terminates as superseded_policy via StateMachine CAS, not forever stalled work. Missing mismatched deployment config remains diagnostically stalled until activation/repair; no bytes read or fake clean. Native CLI supplies proper configured tenant middleware restoration before dispatch; scanner worker never calls withoutTenancy.
Exact drive service entrypoints: ScanWorkReconciler::reconcile(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30,bool $dryRun=false):array; ScanBackfillReconciler::expand(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30):array; UploadCleanupReconciler::reconcile(int $limit=100,int $maxSeconds=30,bool $dryRun=false):array. Commands validate scope/flags then invoke services with bounded selected drive context; returned summaries conform prescribed JSON counters, not arbitrary container callbacks. No command executes scanner synchronously; dispatcher only publishes scoped jobs after commit.
--request-id accepts canonical UUIDv4 (lowercase normalized from valid UUIDv4 string); malformed/nil/other opaque text return2 before SQL. --after requires HMAC signature and same stable request-id/spec/scope; --revision keys resolved in selected drive, not used to derive tenant privilege. Initial run request-id generated server-side UUIDv4; no admission boundary from that timestamp.

## C04: guard taxonomy and feature matrix

P3.1 introduces core Enums/Operations/OperationKind Metadata/Mutation/ContentEgress/Purge; OperationGuard::authorize(OperationContext $context, Ability $ability, Node $node, OperationKind $operation=OperationKind::Metadata):void; authorizeCreate(OperationContext $context,Node $parent):void. Actor resolves first (missing401), locator/persisted drive+tenant (foreign404), user View (hidden404), user ability (403), effective profile operation gate (403), data invariants; system bypasses ONLY two ACL checks. Scanner claim/read uses its private service, never public OperationKind parameter as a capability.
| Operation | User ACL | Relevant feature/policy | Scan/public availability | Scope/locks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Metadata/list/abilities/history/handler descriptor | View + named ability where norm asks | listing/type/read policy; no upload/download requirement invented | metadata without bytes/URL remains visible even quarantine | persisted drive/tenant, fresh ACL each call |
| create/ingest/addRevision/restoreRevision | Create destination, Edit target as applicable | upload size/MIME/extension; resumable enabled only protocol initiate/patch/complete | destination admission; infected content cannot launder | T/N/F/R/Q/C + expectation |
| rename/update/move/trash/trash restore | Edit/Move/Trash/Restore + actual destination Create | operation policy; neither scan engine health nor upload MIME gates deletion/rename | no bytes; trash restore reevaluates current policy on later egress | fresh under family locks |
| grant/share/comment | View + Share/Comment/Manage | grants/share_links/comments AND global/profile | mint metadata token has no clean promise, each later download gate | target membership, no foreign rows |
| file read/download/preview/thumbnail/export bytes | View + Download (Copy uses Copy on source) or scoped share credential | profile/content egress policy, sharing flags for share lane | exact revision compatible clean if eligible, infected always denied | before bytes/URL/304, stream close finally |
| private scanner | authoritative claim capability, not user/system Download | configured scanner + matching spec/attempt; ignores public egress restrictions | can read exact quarantined immutable revision | tenant/job validated before bytes; IO outside tx |
| purge/trash empty/GC/sweep/reconcile | Delete for public purge; explicit system for maintenance | retention/eligibility/CAS safety; NO upload/resumable/download/scan-required feature gate | infected cleanup allowed, no egress | tenant or narrow maintenance bypass + T/N/F/R/Q/C, no public bypass |
Existing profile public API has no download(bool)/uploadsEnabled(bool) setter; this design does not invent one. Contract's download restriction is ACL Download/current effective egress policy; profile UploadPolicy gates admission, not purge. shareLinks(false), comments(false), grants(false), configured resumable=false have concrete gates above. System+profile share disabled stays403; system infected public stream423; system foreign drive404. ProfileGuardBoundaryTest tests all four guard surfaces including authorizeCreate/visible/abilities; inactive features narrow capability projection, no ACL-derived cross-request cache. P3.6 real wiring, P3.8 current tenant/private capability integration.

There is currently no installed preview/thumbnail derivative byte cache or conditional304 branch in these controllers. EgressInventoryTest asserts this fact over declarations/callers and checks descriptors are authority-free; do not invent a successful revoke-cache test over a nonexistent endpoint. Available protected HTTP responses set Cache-Control: private, no-store; no conditional304 added in P3. If host introduces derivative cache it must store exact source revision identity and re-enter live guard for each serve; future concrete P4.4/P6.1/P6.3 contracts require actual cache/304 proof. Inline documents are already guarded egress but full versioned immutable document availability/scanning belongs P4 lifecycle, not fake status on DocumentRevision.
Core Content/ContentDelivery owns stream(OperationContext,Node,FileRevision):FileStream, streamForShare(ShareContext,Node,FileRevision):FileStream and directUrl(OperationContext,Node,FileRevision,int $ttlSeconds):SignedContentUrl. Reload key only, authoritative file/node/drive/blob/edge; exact generation/version selection then auth/profile/scan check immediately before raw read/sign. Public share remains mediated even when direct opt-in enabled; no new route/JSON URL field in P3. FileStream signature unchanged. Strong ETag full-dependency choice remains P6, bare sequence never advertised sufficient; no hidden→304.
Core vaulter.downloads.delivery_mode='strict' default; enum strict/direct_signed, direct_ttl_seconds=60, maximum300. Explicit direct_signed requires bound Contracts/Cas/DirectContentUrlSigner with sign(ImmutableContentIdentity $content,DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt):SignedContentUrl; require exact trusted storage_version OR immutable write-once key guarantee stated by adapter, actual signer expiresAt<=now+300 and identity==selected object. No compatible signer→boot config error; unsupported adapter→explicit failure before raw temporaryUrl, no fallback. SignedContentUrl readonly(url,expiresAt,contentIdentity,storageVersion); constructors reject arbitrary expiry, service checks returned identity/time. No URLs in descriptors/activity/logs/evidence. Lower configured TTL1..300 valid; requested ttl above configured max rejected, no silent provider extension.
Strict mode directUrl fails ProfileRestriction before signer; direct mode fresh sign request rechecks same ACL/scan and is intentionally a bounded bearer capability. App revoke/quarantine blocks next gateway/sign request; issued direct URL remains until expiry/storage-policy deny, already started stream may continue. Trusted IAM/TBAC optional adapter with separate update protocol, not core default guarantee. Tests fake signer exact object/expiry and app revoke semantics, not real cloud revocation. P4.4 exporters and P6.1/P6.3 HTTP/client caching/ETag/If-Match stay assigned by correction contract.

## C03: resource ownership and outer commit cleanup

Extend upload_sessions add result_blob_id nullable IdStrategy FK reference; input_fingerprint nullable char64; cleanup_pending bool defaultfalse; cleanup_attempts integer default0>=0; cleanup_available_at nullable timestamp; cleanup_last_reason nullable varchar32; INDEX(status,cleanup_pending,cleanup_available_at,id). Existing result_node_id/result_revision_id/assembled_blob_id reused, not added twice. Legacy committed pointers backfill ONLY if persisted identities provably resolve same node/revision/blob; otherwise explicit UploadConflictException/recovery diagnostic, no guessed head. Schema fixture checks additive migration and old rows. cleanup pending can preserve committed staged bytes until recovered, never authority to create revision.
CompleteUploadAction resource-owner try/finally starts immediately after first staged read acquisition; MIME sniff+inspection are inside it, sniff stream has its own nested finally. PreparedUpload owns temp and its open streams, borrowed caller resource/PSR never closes. Source staging once outside retry, SQL retry reuses immutable prepared bytes; complete keeps existing session mutex through outer transaction, sweeper/abort cannot delete mid-read. Server input_fingerprint = hash(protocol upload id, actor ref/session owner, drive/tenant, target node/parent, normalized filename/options including original expectation, actual sha/size/detected MIME); ignored client correlation changes do not alter identity. Client supplied blob/url/type/id cannot fill pointers.
Same Vaulter OUTER transaction commits node/revision/head, CAS edge+quota, own scan obligation/request, session status=committed/result node/revision/blob/input_fingerprint and cleanup_pending=true/cleanup_available_at=now. markCommitted CAS requires authoritative Assembled session, all pointer relationships verified. CompleteUploadAction's nested transaction return is never cleanup permission. VaulterDatabase::afterCommit registers cleanup callback on actual outermost connection. Callback reloads committed session + mutex and exact staging owner key, deletes staging, clears flag in own short tx; deletion failure safe report, durable pending remains; action committed result stays successful. Queue publish and cleanup callbacks both best-effort wakeups, independently recoverable, no throw erases committed result.
Outer rollback removes aggregate/pointers/work and returns session to original persisted assembled state, staged protocol source retained; callbacks do not run. Prepared CAS temporary resources still finally-cleaned; promoted unreferenced CAS objects handled by existing P1 orphan saga, not promise zero physical writes. Retry can reprepare from retained protocol staging. Crash after commit before callbacks: scan reconciler discovers obligation and committed cleanup flag. Crash after staging deletion before flag clear: idempotent delete/missing path counts cleanup success. Successful replay skips staging/ingest, may request cleanup wakeup, checks live scope/auth/payload, returns stored result once. Recovery never guesses successful head or re-ingests committed session.
P3.7 explicit files session model/store, CompleteUploadAction, UploadSessionManager, StagedUpload, Content/UploadCleanupReconciler plus scan reconciler command integration. Abort/expire existing CAS and safety semantics retained; product change focuses committed upload cleanup, not unsolicited lease redesign. C03 fault cases isolate postcommit cleanup from mandatory domain/event staging correction C05 (P5.1). No promise current swallowed RecordsOutbox is already atomic.

## D06 failure playbook и future ownership

Config missing scanner/spec/rollout or stale deployed spec: fail closed, safe configuration error, repair binding/config and explicit activation; no implicit mode off. Scanner deterministic failure: settled failed with reason, required egress423; fix cause then explicit rescan request. Transient timeout/broker outage: bounded retry/republication, inspect durable state, no status clean by fallback. Lease stale/deleted identity: no-op/no foreign write, retained newer state. Corrupt immutable identity/tenant: deny before bytes, report safe code, stop+escalate owner; don't repair by taking caller blob/key. SQL deadlock retries bounded existing transaction3, name UNIQUE retry5, original expectation/source retained; exhausted failure rollback, never relax expectation. Counter overflow/negative schema failure: rollback+409/invalid argument, stop+escalate owner; no rollover or schema widening. Postcommit cleanup failure: return committed result, durable pending recovery; outer rollback retain staging. Schema engine/check unsupported or required PG/MySQL proof skipped/empty: stop item finish and escalate explicit missing qualification, don't call pass. Drift outside declared source closure: preserve unrelated changes, recalculate impacted qualification; source OPUS byte drift stop+owner escalation, no source rewrite. Incompatible unforeseen contract: stop+new D#, no implementation improvisation.
